control_failures.control_label: integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas
authorisation of switching and access to apparatus
proving zero energy before intrusive work

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: stored energy found after isolation of SG-4100

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control HAZARDOUS_AREA_EQUIPMENT_INTEGRITY: the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.

Control SWITCHING_AUTHORISATION: the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas on SG-4100 and TX-3002 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling access to energised apparatus, specifically switching, racking and access authorisation. SG-4100 (switchgear and transformers) is in service for plant HV/LV distribution. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas was never verified as effective. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 29 May 2012 a hazard report was recorded on SG-4100 and TX-3002 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during commissioning of replacement equipment; thermal energy held as hot surface was not released.
